garbage_collection.description: SSD garbage collection: copying valid pages to new block, erasing old block with invalid pages

trim_command.description: TRIM command flow: filesystem notifies controller of freed pages enabling proactive garbage collection

nvme_comparison.description: SATA (1 queue, 32 depth) vs NVMe (65K queues, 65K depth) with IOPS and latency numbers

summary.description: Summary: SSD key numbers, best practices (TRIM, overprovisioning), and database workload implications
